question: Should Control UI gain a separate expanded modal composer for long prompts now that current main already has a configurable send shortcut and redesigned inline composer?
rationale: The remaining work is a new user-facing compose mode with UX, accessibility, and draft-ownership choices rather than a broken existing contract, so automation should not decide the product direction.

options.title: Keep for modal design
options.body: Keep this issue open and design a first-class expanded composer modal with explicit Apply, Cancel, and Send behavior.

options.title: Prefer inline growth only
options.body: Narrow or close this issue if maintainers decide the redesigned inline composer plus send shortcut is the supported long-prompt solution.

options.title: Track broader composer UX
options.body: Supersede this into a broader Control UI composer ergonomics thread if one design surface should cover long prompts, shortcuts, attachments, and modal behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep for modal design
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and design a first-class expanded composer modal with explicit Apply, Cancel, and Send behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged composer redesign owns the surrounding Control UI composer layout where this modal affordance would integrate.
